Answer: C
Reason: The axial CT images (Figures 4a and 4b) clearly demonstrate hyperdense, metallic-attenuation material within the branching pulmonary arteries, which is characteristic of polymethylmethacrylate (cement) embolism, a known complication of vertebroplasty. This finding correlates with the intraoperative drop in end-tidal CO2 caused by acute pulmonary vascular obstruction.
